decisions.reason: The source changes visual treatment and prominence but does not change the required business name or strapline wording.
The source evaluates delivered concepts and requests visual revisions; it does not change the obligation to provide the initial concept set.
The requested design variants do not alter the requirement that the artwork be fresh and original.
The preference for graduated orange changes the logo's visual color treatment but does not change the separate obligation to establish and supply brand color documentation.
